text: A long memory isn’t half as useful as a long purse! I dare say it relieves your feelings a good deal to plan out all sorts of dreadful things to do to me, but is that practical? Revenge is very unsatisfactory. Every one always says so. But money”--Tuppence warmed to her pet creed--“well, there’s nothing unsatisfactory about money, is there?” “Do you think,” said Mrs. Vandemeyer scornfully, “that I am the kind of woman to sell my friends?” “Yes,” said Tuppence promptly.
